bit_numbering: LSB0; integer bit i is state bit i
sbox_layer: Apply the listed 4-bit S-box independently to nibbles state[4*j+3:4*j], j=0..15.

p_layer.meaning: input bit i becomes output bit P(i)

round_semantics: For i=0..5, XOR the same arbitrary 64-bit K_i into all four lanes, then apply the S-box layer. Apply pLayer after rounds i=0..4 only; the last pLayer is omitted. A common final key XOR, if included, does not change any boundary XOR and may be omitted.
round_key_quantification: K_0,...,K_5 are existential and independent across rounds, but K_i is shared by all four lanes in round i.
decision_problem: Decide the existential four-state/shared-round-key formula exactly. SAT requires a concrete witness. UNSAT requires a complete solver result plus a checkable contradiction or equivalent finite certificate. A timeout or failure to find a witness is not UNSAT.
local_table_definition: For four nibble inputs a0..a3 and bj=S(aj), define Din=(a0 xor a1,a2 xor a3,a1 xor a2,a0 xor a3) and Dout=(b0 xor b1,b2 xor b3,b1 xor b2,b0 xor b3). Enumerating all 16^4 input quartets gives an exact generalized connectivity relation and may be used as a local certificate.
